probe_fstab:
# TWRP v1 syntax: mount-point filesystem block-device flags.
# Probe profile: NO /data, /cache, /misc or firmware partitions.
# ro is a default, not an access-control boundary against root or an updater ZIP.
/system ext4 /dev/block/mmcblk0p20 flags=fsflags=ro,noload;backup=1;wipeingui=0;canbewiped=0
/boot emmc /dev/block/mmcblk0p8 flags=backup=1;flashimg=0;wipeingui=0;canbewiped=0
/recovery emmc /dev/block/mmcblk0p9 flags=backup=1;flashimg=0;wipeingui=0;canbewiped=0
